addition_commands_if_missing.note: If entries are missing, the following console commands can add them (requires editor Python):
addition_commands_if_missing.code:
import unreal
config = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset('/Game/MelodiaIntegration/Config/DA_MelodiaIntegrationConfig')
allowlist = config.get_editor_property('default_group').get_editor_property('allowlist')
missing = ['quest.shorewake.initiation', 'flag.quest.shorewake_completed', 'flag.sea_above.starskiff_ready', 'reward.shorewake_weave']
for entry in missing:
    if entry not in allowlist:
        allowlist.append(entry)
config.get_editor_property('default_group').set_editor_property('allowlist', allowlist)
unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(config)
